title: Review using sepo for conducting repo-level autoresearch
body:
@sepo-agent /answer 

With the recently added #451 , plus our goal system, as well as other components like task orchestration, how far away we are from conducting repo level autoresearch?

nodes.body:
**Short answer:** for metric-driven repository optimization, Sepo is about **three focused implementation slices plus dogfooding** from an autonomous, single-lane v0. The outer control plane largely exists; the defining experiment loop does not. Open-ended research without a stable evaluator is considerably farther away.

Autoresearch’s core loop is constrained edit → fixed-budget evaluation → deterministic metric comparison → keep/discard → repeat ([README](https://github.com/karpathy/autoresearch#how-it-works), [experiment loop](https://github.com/karpathy/autoresearch/blob/master/program.md#the-experiment-loop)). Sepo now provides:

- Goal issues with success criteria, child decomposition, stopping conditions, and explicit experiment guidance: [`goals.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/docs/architecture/goals.md#L5-L70).
- [#451](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/451), which periodically selects one goal-aligned issue or PR and dispatches orchestration: [`agent-self-improvement.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/prompts/agent-self-improvement.md#L14-L97).
- Meta-orchestration that delegates child issues, resumes the parent from terminal child outcomes, and runs implementation/review/fix/approval/merge chains: [`agent-orchestrator.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/docs/architecture/agent-orchestrator.md#L97-L140).
- Repository skills that can become experiment-specific evaluators or compute adapters: [`skills.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/docs/customization/skills.md#L21-L80).
- A safe promotion path for successful code through review, self-approval, and self-merge.

The critical missing layer is **structured experiment execution**. Current orchestration actions contain only `implement`, `review`, `fix-pr`, self-approve, and self-merge—there is no experiment action or result type: [`handoff.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/handoff.ts#L1-L7). Consequently, Sepo cannot yet:

- define a trusted evaluator, metric direction, baseline, threshold, editable paths, and trial budget;
- execute an isolated candidate and deterministically classify it as improved, regressed, crashed, or inconclusive;
- retain or discard candidates without opening/reviewing a PR for every failed trial;
- pass structured trial results back to the goal planner;
- replan from accumulated evidence rather than coarse `done`/`failed` workflow outcomes.

The intended architecture should be:

```text
#451 portfolio selection
  -> agent-goal issue
  -> meta-orchestrator
  -> experiment child
  -> experiment skill/action
  -> deterministic result reducer
  -> next trial | promoted PR | stop
```

Here, #451 is the **portfolio manager**, not the per-trial loop. A skill owns how to evaluate one repository; core runtime owns trial state, comparison, budgeting, and promotion.

A practical delivery sequence is:

1. Add an `agent-experiment` child convention plus `ExperimentSpec` and `ExperimentResult`. V0 needs one scalar metric, direction, trusted evaluation skill/command, editable-path allowlist, baseline, minimum delta, timeout, and max trials. Record results through marker-upserted issue comments and workflow artifacts.

2. Add a single-lane experiment action. Run one candidate in an isolated branch/worktree, keep the evaluator from the trusted default branch, parse the metric deterministically, and promote only improved candidates into a PR.

3. Integrate it with orchestration. Return structured results to the parent goal and support `next experiment`, `promote`, and `stop`, with trial/cost budgets distinct from the existing orchestration-round budget.

4. Dogfood one short, deterministic goal for 10–20 trials. Only after that add long-running submit/poll/finalize backends, parallel lanes, noisy or multi-metric evaluation, and external artifact storage.

Operationally, this repository is still pre-dogfood: self-improvement is opt-in and a [recent scheduled run was skipped](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/actions/runs/29700979285), while the [`agent-goal` issue query](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3Aagent-goal) is currently empty.

To start the first bounded slice, send:

`@sepo-agent /implement Add autoresearch v0 experiment primitives: an agent-experiment issue contract, ExperimentSpec/ExperimentResult parsing, deterministic metric comparison, a marker-upserted result ledger, and tests/docs; leave execution and orchestrator integration for follow-up PRs.`
